sections.title: MID MO VALLEY TO TX COAST
sections.text: MIDLEVEL LOW CENTERED NEAR THE CO/KS BORDER AS OF 12Z WILL SLOWLY PROGRESS ESEWD THROUGH THE CNTRL PLAINS THIS PERIOD. THIS SYSTEM WILL BE ATTENDED BY A VORTICITY MAXIMUM AND 45-50 KT MIDLEVEL JET STREAK WHICH WILL TRANSLATE FROM NM INTO ERN PARTS OF KS/OK AND NRN TX BY 13/00Z. IN THE LOW LEVELS...SURFACE CYCLONE N OF HLC WILL CONCURRENTLY DEVELOP EWD TO SERN NEB/NERN KS BY LATE AFTERNOON OR EARLY EVENING. TRAILING PACIFIC FRONT WILL ALSO SHIFT E INTO ERN PARTS OF KS/OK AND CNTRL TX DURING THIS TIME. THIS BOUNDARY WILL LIKELY SERVE AS THE FOCUS OF STRONG-SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY INTO TONIGHT. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM THE OZARKS SWD INTO LOWER MS VALLEY...WWD INTO CNTRL TX WILL WASH OUT TODAY ALLOWING FOR THE NWD FLUX OF AN INCREASINGLY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER INTO THE REGION AHEAD OF PACIFIC FRONT. WHEN COUPLED WITH DAYTIME HEATING AND STEEP LAPSE RATE PLUME ATTENDING ABOVE-MENTIONED MIDLEVEL IMPULSE...AFTERNOON AIR MASS IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MODERATELY TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE VALUES OF 2000-3000+ J/KG. WHILE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE BY AFTERNOON ALONG THE LENGTH OF THE PACIFIC FRONT...THE GREATEST PROBABILIT

sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES/UPPER OH VALLEY
sections.text: A SERIES OF WEAK VORTICITY MAXIMA CRESTING LARGE-SCALE RIDGE AXIS ARE EXPECTED TO SUPPORT EPISODIC STRONG-SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT TODAY...FOCUSED INVOF SURFACE WARM FRONT. UPSTREAM SOUNDING DATA INDICATE THE PRESENCE OF 30-35 KT SWLY WINDS IN THE MIDLEVELS. WHEN COUPLED WITH THE WARMING/DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER...SETUP WILL BE SUPPORTIVE OF MULTICELL CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF HAIL AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..MEAD/GRAMS.. 05/12/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PORTIONS OF SRN WI
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM ERN OH/WRN PA TO WV...

sections.title: TX TO LOWER MS VALLEY
sections.text: MATURE LINEAR MCS WILL MOVE TOWARD THE TX GULF COAST AND ENCOUNTER WARMER AIR ALOFT THAT MAY LEAD TO ITS EVENTUAL DEMISE. THIS SYSTEM WAS BEING DRIVEN PRIMARILY BY FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC REGIME AND LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND FASTER MID LEVEL FLOW NOW ROUNDING THE BASE OF THE LARGER SCALE DEEP-LAYER CYCLONE ACROSS WRN KS/NEB ATTM. LIFT WITHIN/BENEATH RIGHT ENTRANCE REGION OF MID LEVEL JET STREAK CROSSING RED RIVER WILL LIKELY AID ADDITIONAL AFTERNOON TSTM DEVELOPMENT FROM NERN TX ACROSS ERN OK AND WRN AR. THIS WILL ALSO COINCIDE WITH ARRIVAL OF A WEAK COLD FRONT INTO THESE AREAS. EXPECT STORMS TO GROW UPSCALE AND BE MAINTAINED EWD ACROSS MUCH OF AR TOWARD THE MS VALLEY THROUGH LATE TONIGHT. INCREASING DEEP LAYER SHEAR AND STEEPENING LAPSE RATES WITH THE APPROACH OF THE UPPER TROUGH WILL FURTHER AID STORM ORGANIZATION AND INTENSITY WITH BOTH WIND AND SEVERE HAIL THREATS INCREASING. TORNADO POTENTIAL IS MORE UNCERTAIN GIVEN LIKELY TRANSITION TO LINEAR MODE WITH TIME AND OTHER COMPLICATING FACTORS REGARDING OVERALL STORM EVOLUTION. HOWEVER...LOCAL STORM SCALE ENHANCEMENT TO THE LOW LEVEL FLOW COULD RESULT IN A COUPLE OF TORNADOES.

sections.title: ERN OK/KS ACROSS MO
sections.text: SOME GREATER UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING STORM DEVELOPMENT WITH NWD EXTENT ALONG THE COLD FRONT. HOWEVER...LARGE SCALE ASCENT AND FRONTAL LIFT SHOULD SUPPORT SOME STORM DEVELOPMENT THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING FROM NERN OK INTO SRN MO. REGIME HERE SHOULD ALSO SUPPORT HAIL/WIND AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO.

sections.title: NEB/IA
sections.text: COLD CORE LOW WILL SPREAD EAST ACROSS ZONE OF RELATIVELY STRONG INSOLATION TO SUPPORT LOW-TOPPED STORMS WITH A CHANCE FOR SEVERE HAIL THIS AFTERNOON. FARTHER EAST...LOW LEVEL SHEAR ALONG THE BOUNDARY DRAPED ACROSS IA...COUPLED WITH DIURNAL HEATING...MAY LEAD TO A FEW ROTATING STORMS WITH SOME CHANCE FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES.

sections.title: WI
sections.text: SIMILAR TO YESTERDAY...WEAK IMPULSE DEVELOPING NEWD FROM ERN IA AND CRESTING UPPER RIDGE AXIS SHOULD AID STORM DEVELOPMENT COINCIDENT WITH DIURNAL HEATING AND WEAK SURFACE LOW. MAGNITUDE OF SHEAR AND INSTABILITY ARE EXPECTED TO SUPPORT A FEW SUPERCELLULAR STORMS WITH HAIL AND ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: LOWER MI ACROSS OH VALLEY TO APPALACHIANS
sections.text: STEEP LAPSE RATES AND LOW AMPLITUDE PERTURBATIONS SPREADING ESEWD ALONG THE ERN FLANK OF THE UPPER RIDGE SHOULD RESULT IN POCKETS OF GREATER SEVERE STORM POTENTIAL FROM OH SWD TO THE CNTRL AND SRN APPALACHIANS.

sections.title: FL
sections.text: SEA BREEZE INTERACTIONS AMIDST STRONG INSTABILITY AND WEAK INHIBITION SHOULD SUPPORT ROBUST MARGINALLY ORGANIZED STORMS ACROSS THE CNTRL AND WRN/SWRN SECTIONS OF FL PENINSULA THIS AFTERNOON. LOCALLY DAMAGING DOWNBURST AND HAIL EVENTS MAY ENSUE WITH THIS CONVECTION. ..CARBIN/COHEN/DIAL.. 05/12/2011

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF WI
sections.text: ...MID MO VALLEY SWD TO THE TX GULF COAST... FORECAST REMAINS ON TRACK ACROSS THE NRN 2/3 OF THIS REGION...WITH STORMS NOW INTENSIFYING IN NEB AND VICINITY NEAR THE UPPER CIRCULATION CENTER...AND DEVELOPMENT LIKELY TO OCCUR ACROSS ERN KS/ERN OK AND INTO N TX IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. BIGGEST CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE FARTHER S INTO TX...WHERE THE LARGE MCS CONTINUES TO APPROACH/REACH THE TX COAST. WITH LITTLE DEVELOPMENT LIKELY WEST OF THIS SYSTEM AND A SLOW DECREASE IN CONVECTIVE INTENSITY WITH ONSHORE STORMS...HAVE DROPPED SLIGHT RISK FROM THIS AREA WITH ONLY ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ALONG THE LEADING ARC OF CONVECTION EXPECTED THE REMAINDER OF THE AFTERNOON. ELSEWHERE -- ACROSS BOTH WI AND ACROSS THE UPPER OH VALLEY AREA...STORMS CONTINUE -- ALONG WITH ISOLATED POTENTIAL FOR HAIL AND/OR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY CONTINUE TO SPREAD SWD OUT OF WV AND ACROSS WRN VA/WRN NC AND POSSIBLY WRN SC...BUT EXPECT THREAT HERE TO REMAIN ISOLATED. ..GOSS.. 05/12/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1136 AM CDT THU MAY 12 2011/
